title: An evaluation of LLMs for political bias in Western media: Israel-Hamas and Ukraine-Russia wars

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying news articles from the BBC and The Guardian regarding the Russia-Ukraine and Israel-Hamas wars into Left, Centre, or Right political leanings using BERT, Gemini, and DeepSeek, and comparing the differing classification baselines across models to evaluate both media bias shifts and the underlying political biases of the LLMs themselves.
